Subject: Inquiry: residency + HSM + audit log pricing for PHI pilot

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We are finalizing vendor options for a small PHI pilot (internal care triage) and wanted to get concrete pricing and packaging on three items:

- Data residency (us-east-1, single-tenant VPC option)
- HSM-backed key management & per-seat HSM gateway charges (required for our HIT environment)
- Audit logging (structured event stream; retention options up to 12 months)

Two asks from our side: one, a price breakdown by line item (monthly and annualized). Two, what concessions you could give for a 12-month committed pilot + potential enterprise expansion in Q1. We are sensitive to per-seat HSM fees and would expect some amortized credit if we commit.

I've attached a short RFP summary with the required controls and estimated usage profile. Can you send a proposal by EOD Tuesday PST? If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min call tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
BrightHealth Tech

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the details and the RFP. Quick read and attached a draft SOW + a pricing sheet for the HSM seats for visibility. High-level proposal below (preliminary, subject to legal/infra validation):

- Residency (VPC, us-east-1, single-tenant control plane): $2,500 / month (flat), includes private control plane and audit log ingestion endpoint.
- HSM gateway: $1,200 / active HSM seat / month (covers HSM gateway, key rotation support).
- Audit logs: baseline 30 days included; 90-day retention tier at $500 / month; 12-month retention at $1,800 / month (indexed, queryable).

Concession proposal for 12-month committed pilot:
- Pilot credit: 100% audit-log storage credits for first 90 days (we absorb first window to accelerate onboarding).
- HSM concession: 10% credit on HSM seat fees for first 12 months if you commit to a 12-month paid pilot and a written roadmap to expand by Q1.
- Residency setup fee waived for pilot.

If BrightHealth can commit to an annualized volume (>= $120k ARR equivalent across the account) we can layer incremental credits (additional HSM seat credit or 6 months extended audit credits).

I attached: SOW_draft_v3.pdf and HSM_pricing_sheet.xlsx for line-item math. Would you be able to share an estimated count of active HSM seats for the pilot? 2–5 seats is what we typically see.

Happy to jump on a call tomorrow at 10am PST to walk through.

Best,

Naomi —

Thanks for the quick proposal and the materials. Two quick items from procurement:

1) HSM fee is the primary blocker. The pilot budget assumes 3 active seats. Given the sensitivity of keys, we need HSM for all production traffic. Can you confirm the monthly commitment if we lock 3 seats? The 10% on the HSM helps but procurement is asking for a deeper amortization. Specifically, they want 20% credit on seat fees applied up front and amortized over 12 months (or a $ fixed credit to offset ramp).

2) Audit logs: the 90-day credit is helpful, but given we need 12 months of retention for compliance review, they'd like 6 months of free audit-log retention and then a step-down discounted rate for months 7–12 (we're proposing 50% off months 7–12).

If Redwood can accept those two concessions (20% up-front HSM credit amortized; 6 months free audit logs + 50% off for months 7–12), we can sign the pilot SOW this week and route for DocuSign.

I pasted your message below for context.

—Elena

Subject: Fwd: Inquiry: residency + HSM + audit log pricing for PHI pilot — approval request

Ben / Marissa —

FYI and request for approval. BrightHealth is asking for stronger concessions than my standard pilot pack. Summary of the ask:

- 3 HSM seats for pilot; they want 20% credit on HSM seat fees applied up front and amortized over 12 months.
- Audit logs: 6 months free retention, months 7–12 at 50% discount.
- Residency setup waived already in our offer; they also asked for DocuSign turn-around this week.

Impacts and thinking:
- Baseline math (3 seats): at $1,200/seat/month -> $3,600 / month (HSM). 20% credit amortized = $720 / month effective reduction over 12 months (or $8,640 gross concession).
- Audit logs at 12-month quoted = $1,800 / month. Offering 6 months free + 50% off months 7–12 = first 6 months $0, next 6 months $900/month -> effective 50% reduction across year -> ~$10,800 concession annualized.
- Combined first-year concession ~ $19.4k (we can tighten via usage floors).

Proposed compromise we can offer without loop to finance:
- Approve up-to 15% HSM seat credit (amortized over 12 months) + 4 months free audit log retention + 50% off months 5–12.
- Add a usage floor: pilot minimum bill of $40k for the 12 months. If they hit >$120k ARR equivalent, we escalate to an additional 5% HSM credit and extend audit credits by 2 months.

If you approve, I'll send updated SOW and DocuSign link with the accelerators and the usage-floor language. If you want to be more aggressive (i.e., grant full 20%), recommend Marissa escalate since it exceeds the 15% discount guardrail.

Thanks —
Naomi
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
